    Class PrefsList<T>

    Wrapper for a list that is stored in Unity's PlayerPrefs. This class allows you to store and retrieve a list of items in PlayerPrefs, while ensuring type safety and automatic serialization/deserialization.

    PrefsList<T> is separate from Prefs<T> in order to track the list's data changes like adding or removing items.

    Supported types for the list items include: int, float, string, bool, UnixTime, Vector2, Vector3, Quaternion, and more.
